usedFor: Attio holds the records, notes and tasks, and Calendly makes a booking link from them through “Create Scheduling Link”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Task Created” in Attio, then “Create Scheduling Link” in Calendly
bestTemplate.why: A fresh task is a natural point to prepare a booking link for the follow-up meeting.

watchOut: “Record Updated” in Attio fires on every update, so one record can create several scheduling links.
